description: This file is a PHP script that primarily generates an HTML page for a 'Change Password' interface within a troubleshooting section. It includes external PHP headers, sets up a form with validation rules for password change, and contains JavaScript for handling password visibility toggle and form submission via AJAX.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Returns a numeric instance identifier based on the current login user session value.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects the user to 'at_a_glance.php' when cancelling the password change.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends an AJAX POST request to save the new password configuration and alerts the user upon success or failure.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates password inputs and initiates the password change process by calling set_config with the constructed JSON config.
